category_title: At-risk students with learning disabilities who are shy and struggle to articulate ideas from print text
scenario_title: Demonstrating knowledge through traditional writing assignments
minimal_context: The student is working independently to complete two short writing assignments based on a text read in class.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please complete these two short writing assignments based on the text we just finished.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I felt confused by the poem at first and then we reread it and I understood it a little better, but I don't know what to write.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just write down what you remember about the historical events we discussed.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I have a lot of confusion about why Jews were targeted, hated and segregated in Germany at the time of the Third Reich. I can't explain it.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Try your best to put your thoughts on the paper for the assignment.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Writing assignments are more difficult because you have to remember all the information and then put it how you want to say it on paper. But it doesn’t always come out how you want it to.
